{{Short description|German spectroscopist (1956–2020)}}

'''Wolfgang Stahl''' (1 April 1956 in [[Kiel]] – 28 August 2020 in [[Aachen]]) was a German spectroscopist. He was a professor at the [[RWTH Aachen University]].

== Life ==
Wolfgang Stahl finished his [[diploma]] in [[chemistry]] at the [[University of Kiel]] in 1983.<ref name=":3">{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=Nachruf Prof. Dr. Wolfgang Stahl - RWTH AACHEN UNIVERSITY Fachgruppe Chemie - Deutsch|url=https://www.chemie.rwth-aachen.de/cms/Chemie/Die-Fachgruppe/Aktuell/Meldungen-gesamt/~jtmjc/Nachruf-Prof-Dr-Stahl/#aaaaaaaaaajtmqn|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2020-09-19|website=www.chemie.rwth-aachen.de|language=de}}</ref> He received his doctorate in 1987 at the University of Kiel.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.aachen-gedenkt.de/traueranzeige/wolfgang-stahl|title=Wolfgang Stahl Obituary|website=www.aachen-gedenkt.de|language=de|access-date=2020-09-07}}</ref> In 1992, he finished his [[habilitation]] in physical chemistry at the University of Kiel.<ref name=":0" /> Since 1995, he was [[professor]] for molecular spectroscopy at the [[RWTH Aachen University]].<ref name=":0" /> For many years he was chairman of the examination board for chemistry and person in charge for the [[Erasmus Programme]] in chemistry.<ref name=":3" />

== Research ==
His research focused on following topics in the field of microwave spectroscopy:<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=https://www.ipc.rwth-aachen.de/cms/IPC/Forschung/~kwhp/Prof-Wolfgang-Stahl-Molekuelspektrosko/lidx/1/|title=Research group at the RWTH Aachen University|website=www.ipc.rwth-aachen.de|access-date=2020-09-07}}</ref>
* Large amplitude motions in molecules
* Theory of rotational spectra
* Quantum mechanical and group theoretical calculation
* Nuclear quadrupole coupling

== Publications (selection)==
He published 149 journal articles.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web|url=https://www.ipc.rwth-aachen.de/cms/IPC/Forschung/Prof-Wolfgang-Stahl-Molekuelspektrosko/~kwjl/Publikationen/lidx/1/?search=&typeofresource=&originyear=&originikz=&origininstitut=|title=List of publications|website=www.ipc.rwth-aachen.de|access-date=2020-09-07}}</ref> A selected number of his articles for different topics:
